hero.title: Build Your Venture Step by Step, At Your Own Pace
hero.intro: Join the self-paced Academy and learn how to turn an idea into evidence, a product and a business, through 100 interactive lessons. You don't need a business idea to begin.

phases.blurb: Find problems worth solving, understand who has them, and choose an opportunity worth exploring.
phases.outcome: An opportunity brief and a go, refine or pause decision.

phases.blurb: Turn assumptions into evidence through small, ethical customer conversations and tests.
phases.outcome: A customer evidence review and a build decision.

phases.blurb: Design and develop the product and lay the business foundations.
phases.outcome: A working MVP (or service equivalent) and a launch-readiness review.

phases.blurb: Take the product to market with a focused route to real customers, then measure what you learn.
phases.outcome: A launch plan and an honest read on early traction.

phases.blurb: Build the organisation, capital strategy and governance to grow responsibly.
phases.outcome: A long-term venture strategy and graduation review.

features.title: Learn by doing
features.text: Every lesson ends in something you produce: a worksheet, a plan, a one-page brief. No passive watching.

features.title: Downloadable deliverables
features.text: Your work exports as Markdown so you can keep it, share it and build on it.

features.title: Practice with a scripted coach
features.text: Rehearse hard conversations and decisions with guided coach scenarios built into the lessons.

features.title: Quizzes and checkpoints
features.text: Check your understanding as you go and pass a checkpoint before moving to the next phase.

features.title: Honest by design
features.text: The course teaches validation without overclaiming. Evidence is separated from interpretation.

features.title: Pick up where you left off
features.text: Your progress is saved automatically in your browser, lesson by lesson.

steps.title: Start with orientation
steps.text: Set up your founder profile and commitment in a short Module 00.

steps.title: Work through five phases
steps.text: Discover, Validate, Build, Launch, Scale. Twenty lessons each.

steps.title: Graduate with a body of work
steps.text: Finish all 100 lessons and the graduation review with a full set of deliverables.

story.heading: Ever noticed how many ventures start with an answer instead of a question?
paragraphs: Many founders start building before they know the problem is worth solving.
The Academy walks you through five phases, Discover, Validate, Build, Launch and Scale, so every decision rests on evidence instead of guesswork.
It helps you run small, ethical tests and build with clarity, purpose and confidence.
